description: This source file defines the PlatformLabelFormatter enum with static methods for parsing and pretty-printing platform labels such as 'macos', 'ios', etc. It handles string manipulation to extract platform names and versions.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw platform label string into a tuple containing the platform prefix and an optional version string.

methods.name: pretty
methods.description: Converts a raw platform label string into a user-friendly, capitalized platform name with optional version formatting.
